data.summary:
During your Shooting phase, you may pick 1 enemy unit 12" or less from this unit (18" if this unit is led by a Lieutenant in Reiver Armour). It takes a Battle-shock test; a **PSYKER** unit subtracts 1 from the result.

On a failed test, it is **Battle-shocked** and also Stunned until your next Shooting phase starts. Models in a Stunned unit get -1 to the **Hit roll** for their Psychic Attacks.
